title: Locks, Keys and Access Cards for Storage Rentals
content:
Larkspur supplies the lock for some Storage Rental products and not for others; lock, key, access card and access hour terms are set per product.

## Locks and keys

| Storage Rental product | Lock supplied by Larkspur | Charge for a Larkspur-supplied disc lock | Replacement key to a Larkspur-supplied lock |
|---|---|---|---|
| Bike Storage Locker | Yes | $0.00 | $25.00 |
| Small Storage Closet (4x4) | Yes | $0.00 | $25.00 |
| Standard Storage Unit (5x5) | No | $18.00 | $25.00 |
| Large Storage Unit (5x10) | No | $18.00 | $25.00 |
| Climate-Controlled Storage Unit (5x10) | Yes | $0.00 | $25.00 |
| Oversized Storage Suite (10x10) | No | $18.00 | $25.00 |

A lock charge of $0.00 means no lock is sold for that product.

## Access

| Storage Rental product | Storage area open | Access card issued without charge | Each lost or additional access card |
|---|---|---|---|
| Bike Storage Locker | 24 hours | Yes | $20.00 |
| Small Storage Closet (4x4) | 06:00 to 22:00 | Yes | $20.00 |
| Standard Storage Unit (5x5) | 24 hours | Yes | $20.00 |
| Large Storage Unit (5x10) | 24 hours | Yes | $20.00 |
| Climate-Controlled Storage Unit (5x10) | 06:00 to 22:00 | Yes | $20.00 |
| Oversized Storage Suite (10x10) | 24 hours | Yes | $20.00 |

## Points of reference

- **Lock supplied.** Larkspur supplies the lock for the Bike Storage Locker, the Small Storage Closet (4x4) and the Climate-Controlled Storage Unit (5x10), each at $0.00. For the Standard Storage Unit (5x5), the Large Storage Unit (5x10) and the Oversized Storage Suite (10x10) Larkspur does not supply the lock, and the listed charge for a Larkspur-supplied disc lock is $18.00.
- **Restricted hours.** The two interior-corridor products, the Small Storage Closet (4x4) and the Climate-Controlled Storage Unit (5x10), are open 06:00 to 22:00; the other four products are open 24 hours.
- **Uniform charges.** A replacement key is $25.00 and a lost or additional access card is $20.00 for every Storage Rental product.
